messages.text:
The backend contract has to be testable independently of the UI, so the next necessary state is a query/API layer with deterministic seed data before routing polish.

I’m avoiding a fake “server” where the browser computes totals; the DB module will own ranking, totals, revenue, conversion, AOV, category revenue, and daily trend summaries.
